notes: STAGED PROPOSAL ONLY. ZERO IMPLEMENTATION AUTHORITY until this exact finite scope is independently reviewed, merged, and separately promoted into immutable trusted base-state authority. #5069 Phase A only: establish source-faithful EGRUL 4.08/4.07 legal-status and reliability normalization inside the parser plus a pure versioned/hashable FNS status interpreter. Preserve the file information mode (ТипИнф) needed to reason about open/closed/restricted visibility. Under current 4.08 structure, СвСтатус is zero-or-many and is formed for SЮЛСТ statuses >100 and <900; it is deliberately absent for an ordinary acting entity with no listed special process, but may also be omitted from an OPEN-information file for a reorganization status (>120 and <140) when a participating entity has restricted-access facts. Therefore absence of СвСтатус is NOT unconditionally clean ACTIVE. The parser/status envelope must explicitly distinguish at least source-visible special statuses, structurally proven clean-active absence, visibility-restricted/possibly-hidden status, final termination and unknown/incomplete semantics; any ambiguity that can hide reorganization/special state must fail closed to an unknown/reviewable envelope for later policy rather than false clean ACTIVE. Preserve every visible СвСтатус exact КодСтатусЮЛ + НаимСтатусЮЛ + applicable dates/GRN provenance deterministically; do not replace source-provided names with a guessed local dictionary. Preserve СвРешИсклЮЛ minimal decision/publication facts when present (current structure ties it to status codes 105-110). Preserve СвПрекрЮЛ as the final-termination fact; current 4.08 requires it when the legal-entity status code is >200 and <700, so final termination must not be inferred merely from absence/presence of some unrelated field. Reliability normalization is category-only and PII-minimized: preserve address unreliability from СвНедАдресЮЛ/ПризнНедАдресЮЛ (2=tax-authority verification, 3=court), management/authorized-person unreliability category, and participant/founder unreliability category where source-visible, together with non-personal provenance needed for replay; do not copy names, identity documents, birth/address data or court narrative into the normalized status envelope. Multiple simultaneous visible status/reliability facts are retained in stable source order/canonical sort as appropriate and never collapsed to one arbitrary first match. Unknown/new schema-valid status code/name is retained explicitly as OTHER/UNKNOWN_POLICY_MEANING, never erased into clean-active; a code/name contradiction or malformed required status/date/provenance fails closed when safe interpretation is impossible. Existing compatibility active/status fields may remain only as a bounded bridge for unchanged consumers, but they must be derived from the explicit envelope and must never claim active=true when the envelope is final-terminated, special/reviewable, visibility-restricted or unknown. Phase A MUST NOT change Role Eligibility verdict/admission semantics yet: do not wire new fields into evidence minimization, NormalizedOrganizationFacts, role policy, strongContradiction, registration, or enforcement in this slice. Required regressions: ordinary acting entity with structurally safe no-status case; open-file hidden/restricted reorganization case must NOT become clean active; one and multiple visible statuses; codes 105-110 with exclusion decision facts; code-band final termination with СвПрекрЮЛ; liquidation/reorganization/bankruptcy/special states; unreliable address categories 2/3; management/participant unreliability without PII copying; unknown accepted-schema code retained; malformed/conflicting required status/date fail-closed; exact replay hash stability; later official correction yields a distinct deterministic source version without mutating prior facts. Phase B, separately governed after #5067 final current-read-model/evidence surface is stable, will authorize evidence minimization/types/policy integration and derive REVIEW_REQUIRED/strongContradiction from these explicit facts. Explicitly excluded here: FNS acquisition/coverage authority, canonical identity, current-generation admission binding, scheduled recheck, schema/migrations, registration behavior, enforcement activation, production mutation, UI, infrastructure, provider credentials and recurring cost.
